subject: english
stem: A team needs eight markers and has ten. What does enough allow us to infer?
options: The team has at least the required number.
The team has exactly eight markers.
The team has infinitely many markers.

optionRationales.reason: The team has at least the required number.：enough 只保證達門檻。
The team has exactly eight markers.：實際有十支。
The team has infinitely many markers.：不能推論無限。
Every marker is large.：數量不提供尺寸。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「使用 a lot of 表大量，enough 表達達到情境門檻，並依名詞可數性、形容詞位置與明示需求判斷是否充足。」可推出 The team has at least the required number.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 The team has at least the required number. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
